title: Settings Page
content: Build application settings page. Layout: sidebar navigation with main content. Navigation: tabs or sidebar list (Profile, Account, Notifications, Security, Billing). Content sections: card-based with form inputs. Save buttons per section or floating. Success/error feedback. Danger zone: destructive actions with confirmations. Responsive: tabs become dropdown on mobile.

variants.simple: Create settings page with navigation tabs and form sections.
variants.detailed: Build application settings page. Layout: sidebar navigation with main content. Navigation: tabs or sidebar list (Profile, Account, Notifications, Security, Billing). Content sections: card-based with form inputs. Save buttons per section or floating. Success/error feedback. Danger zone: destructive actions with confirmations. Responsive: tabs become dropdown on mobile.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive application settings page. Layout: flex with sidebar (w-64) and main content (flex-1). Sidebar navigation: sticky top-4, space-y-1. Nav items: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg, icon + label, hover:bg-gray-100, active: bg-gray-100 font-medium. Sections: Profile, Account, Notifications, Privacy, Security, Billing, Integrations, API. Grouped with section headers if many. Main content: max-w-3xl py-6 px-8. Page header: section title (text-2xl font-bold), description text (text-gray-600). Content cards: space-y-6. Card: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border p-6. Card header: title (text-lg font-semibold), description (text-sm text-gray-600), optional "Edit" button aligned right. Form sections: space-y-4. Input groups: label (text-sm font-medium), input, helper text (text-xs text-gray-500). Input types: text, select, toggle switches, radio groups, checkboxes. Toggle settings: flex justify-between items-center for label + switch pairs. Save actions: per-card "Save Changes" button (shows when modified), or floating action bar at bottom. Success feedback: toast notification "Settings saved" or inline success text. Notifications section: granular toggles for email, push, SMS per category (Marketing, Product Updates, Security Alerts, Weekly Digest). Privacy section: visibility toggles, data sharing options. Security section: change password form, two-factor auth toggle with setup flow, session management (list active sessions, revoke option). Billing section: current plan card, payment method with last 4 digits, invoices table with download links, cancel subscription with confirmation. Danger zone: bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl, "Delete Account" with confirmation modal. API section: API key display (masked with copy button), regenerate key with confirmation. Mobile: sidebar becomes horizontal tabs or hamburger menu, cards full-width. Loading: skeleton cards while fetching settings. Accessibility: form sections as fieldsets with legends, save status announced.
